items.title: 26.3 Polymer ki qism, repeat unit aur monomers pehchanna (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 26.3 with Quick Check 26.2 answered (PDF 152-154). Answers need review.

blocks.text: Skeletal ya structural formula se polymer pehchanne ke liye dohrane wala linkage (jor) aur monomer units dekhni hoti hain. Is level par sirf do qism ke polymers parhe ja rahe hain:
Poly(ethene) ki misal saamne rakh kar neeche diye gaye steps se polymer ki qism pehchanein.

items: Sab se pehle dekhein ke polymer ki asal (horizontal) chain kin atoms se bani hai, yani backbone pehchanein.
Agar asal chain mein sirf carbon atoms hain (-C-C-C-C-) to yeh addition polymer hai. Aise polymers alkenes se bante hain.
Agar asal chain mein carbon ke saath oxygen (O) ya nitrogen (N) atoms bhi hain to yeh condensation polymer hai (jaise polyesters ya polyamides).

blocks.text: Ab functional linkage pehchanein. Is ki bhi do soorten hain:
i. Agar carbonyl group (C=O) seedha oxygen (O) ke saath laga ho to polymer polyester hai. Maslan PET ke is hisse mein ester linkage hai.

blocks.alt: PET ka hissa bracket mein, subscript n: -C(=O)-benzene ring-C(=O)-O-CH2-CH2-O-. Chhota teer ester linkage ke C=O ki taraf ishara karta hai.
blocks.caption: PET ka hissa aur us ka ester linkage (kitab ke PDF page 152 ki bina number wali figure ke mutabiq hamari drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Teer us C=O ki taraf hai jo O ke saath laga hai; C(=O)-O mil kar ester linkage hai. Bracket ke andar ka hissa PET ka repeat unit hai.
ii. Agar carbonyl group (C=O) seedha aise nitrogen (N) ke saath laga ho jis par hydrogen (H) bhi ho, to yeh amide ya peptide linkage hai, aur polymer polyamide hai (maslan Nylon 6,6 ya Kevlar).

blocks.alt: Kevlar ka hissa: -N(H)-C(=O)-ring-C(=O)-N(H)-ring-N(H)-C(=O)-ring-C(=O)-N(H)-, har C=O oopar aur har N-H neeche, benzene rings ke darmiyan amide links.
blocks.caption: Kevlar ka hissa aur us ke amide linkages (kitab ke PDF page 152 ki bina number wali figure ke mutabiq hamari drawing).
Table 26.1 Polymer ke hisse (section) se us ki qism pehchanna

blocks.text: 2. Repeat unit maloom karna: Asal monomers tak pohanchne ke liye pehle polymer ke hisse mein woh sab se chhota hissa dhoondein jo baar baar dohraya ja raha hai.

items: Dekhein ke tarteeb (sequence) kahan se dobara shuru hoti hai; backbone mein aise dohrane wale hisse pehchanein.
In mein se aik hisse ke gird brackets lagayein aur subscript n likhein. Bracket ke andar ka hissa polymer ka repeat unit hai.

blocks.text: a) Addition polymers ke liye repeat unit ke C-C single bond ko wapas C=C double bond bana dein; yahi monomer hai.

blocks.alt: Addition polymer ka hissa: saat carbon ki displayed chain, har doosre carbon par benzene ring aur baqi par H. Teer se repeat unit [-CH(C6H5)-CH2-]n bracket mein, phir doosre teer se monomer H2C=CH(C6H5) (phenylethene).
blocks.caption: Repeat unit aur monomer ki pehchan (addition) (kitab ke PDF page 153 ki bina number wali figure ke mutabiq hamari drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Chain mein har doosre carbon par benzene ring hai. Repeat unit -CH₂-CH(C₆H₅)- hai. Is ka C-C bond C=C banane se monomer phenylethene (styrene) milta hai.
b) Condensation polymers ke liye paani wapas daalein: ester ya amide bond torein, C=O wali taraf -OH aur O ya N wali taraf -H lagayein.

blocks.alt: Kitab jaisi tarteeb: baen taraf condensation polymer (Kevlar) ka hissa, -NH-CO-ring-CO-NH-ring-NH-CO-ring-CO-NH-; daen taraf teer se repeat unit [-NH-ring-NH-CO-ring-CO-]n; repeat unit se neeche teer se monomers: H2N-ring-NH2 aur HOOC-ring-COOH, ya ClOC-ring-COCl.
blocks.caption: Repeat unit aur monomers ki pehchan (addition) (kitab ke PDF page 153 ki bina number wali figure ke mutabiq hamari drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Har amide link par paani daalne se do monomers milte hain: benzene-1,4-diamine (H₂N-C₆H₄-NH₂) aur benzene-1,4-dicarboxylic acid (HOOC-C₆H₄-COOH), ya acid ki jagah us ka dioyl chloride (ClOC-C₆H₄-COCl).
a) Neeche diye gaye polymer ke hisson ke liye polymerisation ki qism aur monomers batayein.

blocks.alt: Polymer ka displayed hissa: -CH2-NH-CO-CH2-NH-CO-CH2-NH-CO-CH2-; N-H aur C=O groups baari baari oopar aur neeche.
blocks.caption: Quick Check 26.2 a i) polymer ka hissa (kitab ke page 154 par chhape structure ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.prompt: i) Is hisse mein polymerisation ki qism aur monomer kya hai?
blocks.explanation: Chain mein N hai aur C=O seedha N-H ke saath hai, is liye yeh condensation polymer (polyamide) hai. Repeat unit -CH₂-NH-CO- hai; monomer aminoethanoic acid (glycine), H₂N-CH₂-COOH.

blocks.alt: Skeletal (dhaanche wala) polymer hissa: zigzag carbon chain jis ke har doosre carbon par benzene ring hai; chaar rings, siron par dotted lines.
blocks.caption: Quick Check 26.2 a ii) polymer ka hissa (kitab ke page 154 par chhape structure ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.prompt: ii) Is hisse mein polymerisation ki qism aur monomer kya hai?
blocks.explanation: Chain mein sirf carbon hain, is liye addition polymer hai. Repeat unit -CH₂-CH(C₆H₅)-; monomer phenylethene (styrene), CH₂=CH-C₆H₅.

blocks.alt: Polymer ka hissa: -CH2CH(CH3)-CH2CH(CH3)-CH2CH(CH3)-; har CH ke oopar CH3, saath Polypropylene likha hai.
blocks.caption: Quick Check 26.2 a iii) polymer ka hissa (kitab ke page 154 par chhape structure ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.prompt: iii) Polypropylene mein polymerisation ki qism aur monomer kya hai?
blocks.explanation: Addition polymer; repeat unit -CH₂-CH(CH₃)-; monomer propene, CH₂=CH-CH₃.

items: Backbone mein sirf carbon: addition; O ya N bhi: condensation.
C=O ke saath O: polyester; C=O ke saath N-H: polyamide.
Sab se chhote dohrane wale hisse par bracket aur n: repeat unit.
Monomer: addition mein C=C wapas banayein; condensation mein ester/amide link par paani daalein.
